_comment: The ramp for gate-frames-schema (scripts/check-frames-schema.mjs). Two checks, both enforced block-now on CHANGED features and reported-only for the pre-existing backlog below — the same changed-scope discipline as gate-ds-conformance's changed-lines ratchet and gate-frames-first's uncovered ramp. This file is the worklist + flip criterion, not automation; the gate reads nothing from it (the changed-feature scope is computed from git). It exists so the backlog has an owner and a finish line.

schema.rule: Every design/frames/<feature>/manifest.json must match the load-bearing shape in design/frames/_template/manifest.schema.json. Enforced for a feature this PR changes; backlog reported only.
schema.backlog_note: EMPTY as of 2026-10-26 — app-specific-menu was brought into schema conformance (added name/description/designSystem/entry + frame label/summary/testHooks, re-stamped) by the frames-ramp burndown. `node scripts/check-frames-schema.mjs --report` now shows 0 manifests with schema errors. The schema half of the flip criterion is met; the mobile half below is not.

mobile.rule: FuzeFront declares mobile required (.fuze/manifest.json). Each flow in build.flows[] must declare mobile coverage — a mobile/responsive frame (frames[].viewport), build.flows[].responsive (mobileFrame or coveredViewports), or responsive.exempt + exemptReason. Enforced for a feature this PR changes; backlog reported only.
mobile.note: Was 58 flows / 22 features (2026-08-18); 51 at the start of the 2026-10-26 frames-ramp pass. That pass cleared 26 flows: mfa-stepup-mobile (frames already authored at 375px — tagged viewport=mobile) and signup-phone-verification (frames render both desktop + 375px — tagged viewport=responsive) got honest viewport tags; and the genuinely desktop-only operator/developer/admin consoles — app-builder, config-management, devportal, employee-console, portal-admin-consoles, api-tokens, app-management, authz-admin, portals-directory — declared build.flows[].responsive.exempt with specific per-flow reasons. The 25 flows left are all END-USER flows that SHOULD be mobile (account/security/onboarding/shell-chrome); they are approved:true already, so adding a real mobile frame is per-feature product-designer design plus owner re-approval, NOT an exemption and NOT a mechanical ramp edit. Run `node scripts/check-frames-schema.mjs --report` for the live count.

flip_to_all.criterion: When both backlogs are empty — `node scripts/check-frames-schema.mjs --all` exits 0 — change the CI step to pass --all so the gate enforces across every feature, not only changed ones. Mirrors flipping gate-frames-first's uncovered.mode to fail.
